integrity_statement: Analytic polynomial identities and the complete symbolic triangulation checks support the claim; no numerical finite samples are represented as an infinite proof.
limitations: The result covers only the explicitly specified four-dimensional two-apex-pair polytope family. It does not imply the general Mahler conjecture. The finite interval-wide determinant checker is independently reproducible, while historical priority and external scientific validation are not independently certified.
title: Exact all-height Mahler product of the symmetric double-corner-apex four-cube
